case: Three reviewed negatives over the disk while its broad extraction (a disk timeline) is attempted: question 1 not determinable on coverage the hub found complete over the disk; question 2, an existence question, a bounded negative that says the event did not happen; question 3 not determinable on coverage that names the disk but is partial (its job read a log).
design: docs/adr/0013 'A source's broad extraction before a negative on it': a material negative that says the event did not happen, or whose coverage is complete over a source, holds (preparation_pending) while that source's broad extraction is planned or attempted; the hold is a defect, fixed by the extraction's outcome or the operator's acceptance, under every stop policy.
docs/adr/0013 the same section: every other material negative on a source whose broad extraction has not produced is warned (preparation_missing), and a warning never holds.
